title: Xaahi xisô mahandasa
intro: ucsub caylale qasriino, maqar kee dudda luk acwa, qaleeli exxaaxil kaxxa buxaaxih weelo. Ta kobox mango leeda kee baxsale xisô handasat le. Takkay ikkah, qado maabitina geenih yaniinim takkay immay, diraamaa kee habbal sinni amoqayxi fan gexa gita dooreenih. atu baxxaaqissam duuddaa ta butta miyyin aydaadi ayfaf adda xeerih yan qasiir inkih abaabta marah?
clues: Nanu maqar kee dudda yomcowweeh, qaxmeqe buxaaxi saanih qaleelal nayyaaqem xiqne.
Nanu Yallak qado asta neh tomcowwe, baxsale ginoy dacarsittoh taqabi sinnim cabte.
Ni ayyunti kaxxiina yekke, farmoyti nek fanak bahte qibaadah farmo gexkalootuk.
Nanu gibdi digaalah maabitina tanim takkay immay, assakat le asta biyaknuh celsisne.
Nanu amri sadah baxsa le gino ni qeelal yaaqubeenim gersi ayroorah addat.
Nanu finqak ellecabot nongoorowe, tiino yoogoreh, bohoy le bakaq ni abtok lakal.

location.label: Ni aydaadih addat tan lafale liyyitte

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. (26:158)
